home.intro: I'm Livi. I help organisations bring structure, clarity and control to complex content ecosystems. From content architecture and governance to platforms and workflows, I build the foundations that make content easier to manage, reuse and scale.

about.title:
A systems mind.
Built for complexity.
about.lede: Making complex content ecosystems simpler, smarter and easier to manage.
about.body:
I work at the intersection of people, platforms and processes, helping organisations get more from their content and the technology behind it.

From content architecture and CMS implementation to DAM, governance and workflows, I connect the moving parts and build solutions that work in practice, not just on paper.

principles.title: People before platforms
principles.body: Technology is only as good as the people using it. I start by understanding the challenges, the users and what actually needs to change.

principles.title: Make complexity manageable
principles.body: I connect the dots between content, technology and teams, turning complicated requirements into clear structures and practical solutions.

principles.title: Build for what comes next
principles.body: Good solutions shouldn't depend on the person who designed them. I focus on creating scalable, sustainable ways of working that last beyond implementation.

home.intro: From intimate parties to international stages. Good music, great crowds and no two sets the same.

about.title:
Open format.
Good instincts.
about.lede: Great music, good energy and a feel for the room.
about.body:
I'm Livi, an open-format DJ with a love for great music, unexpected selections and bringing people together on the dancefloor.

I've played everywhere from intimate private parties to packed dancefloors and international brand events, with sets taking me across London, Las Vegas, Copenhagen, Cannes, Lisbon, Singapore and Zurich.

From iconic venues to international events.

Along the way, I've played at Printworks, Poble Espanyol, Tivoli, Aquário Romano, the Cannes Croisette, Ace Hotel and Be At One, and worked with names including Google, Cannes Lions, Shoptalk, Money20/20, London Pride, Virgin Atlantic, Delta Air Lines and Silent Discos in Incredible Places.

No fixed formula. No predictable playlists.

My sets move across genres and decades, mixing familiar favourites with tracks you didn't know you needed to hear.

Whether I'm building the energy of a packed dancefloor or creating the soundtrack to something more intimate, it's always about finding the right music for the right moment.

principles.title: Parties & celebrations
principles.body: Open-format DJ sets for birthdays, private parties and celebrations. Big singalongs, dancefloor favourites and unexpected tracks that make a night memorable.

principles.title: Weddings & events
principles.body: Music tailored to the occasion, from relaxed receptions and stylish gatherings to full dancefloors. Thoughtful selections, seamless transitions and the flexibility to follow the crowd.

principles.title: Corporate events & sound programming
principles.body: Curated soundtracks for brand experiences, launches and corporate events, including walk-on music, event openings, transitions and bespoke music programming.
